text:
ashley: Heads-up 1: i opened a PR that changes the function-calling example outputs to use a nullable `result` envelope instead of the rigid `output`. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/859

ashley: Summary: examples and parser helpers will accept `result: null` for partial/failed tool runs. SDKs should use `parseRelaxed()` to avoid brittle failures from tiny model hiccups.

mike: can you paste the example replacement?

ashley: sure:```json
// old
{"tool": "geo_lookup", "output": {"city": "SF", "lat": 37.77}}
// new
{"tool": "geo_lookup", "result": {"payload": {"city": "SF", "lat": 37.77}, "confidence": 0.88}}
// or when the tool produced nothing
{"tool": "geo_lookup", "result": null}
```

priya: couple things: 1) how will we signal transient vs permanent failures? 2) do we need to update our parser tests?

ashley: adding an optional `reason` string to the `result` object for human-readable context (e.g., "timeout" or "rate_limited"). Tests: yes, examples test will need to accept both old `output` and new `result` shapes for a migration window.

priya: plan for TS SDK: add `parseRelaxed(respText)` which tries strict JSON, then runs a small pre-cleaner (trim trailing commas, fix unquoted keys, detect bare booleans/nulls) and falls back to JSON5. Will add unit tests for cases we see in the wild. snippet:```ts
// before
const data = JSON.parse(resp.text);
// after
const data = parseRelaxed(resp.text);
```

jordan: i can run a quick grep across docs/examples and auto-patch obvious `"output":` usages to `"result.payload"` with a comment, then open an examples PR. i'll keep replacements conservative so we don't alter intended semantics.

mike: examples site uses some literal JSON files that our link-checker and parser tests validate. doc_bot reported failures earlier when we tried a small refactor. can you run examples smoke after jordan's patch?

ashley: yes, timeline: merge schema + SDK helpers today, example fixes tomorrow. @jordan tag me when the examples PR is ready so i can spot-check. :thumbsup:

jordan: starting grep now. will annotate ambiguous cases with `// REVIEW` and open a PR to examples repo. also will add a small migration note in the docs that `result` can be null and `reason` may be present.

doc_bot: CI note: docs build queued. current run showed 9 docs link-check failures and 3 example snapshot diffs. https://ci.redwood/infer/1257

mike: can someone paste one failing example so i can triage quickly?

ashley: failing example: `examples/funcall/README.md` contains `"output"` examples used by snapshot tests. Needs replacing with `"result.payload"` or updated to account for nullable `result`.

priya: i'll land the SDK patch and unit tests first. mike, can you run smoke locally once jordan's patch is in?

mike: yep, i'll run both local smoke and CI after push. i'll also add a tiny console docs snippet showing `parseRelaxed()` usage to reduce support churn.

ashley: small docs note request: add a one-paragraph explanation under "structured outputs" about the migration, why we permit `null`, and the `reason` field semantics. keep it short.

jordan: will add that paragraph and a client-side redirect for old `output` links (simple rewrite) to avoid 404s while we migrate examples.

ashley: thanks team. if CI is green after these changes i'll merge PR 859 and ship the brief migration note.

mike: nit: consider adding an example of `result` with `confidence` and `reason` in the console quickstart. that'll help folks parse unexpected nulls.

priya: good call 1. i'll include that in the SDK README and the console snippet. also adding tests for edgecases: trailing commas, unclosed arrays, and bare tokens.

ashley: perfect. looping back once examples PR is up. :shipit:
